empty.hint: Slash commands go straight to Claude Code. /new starts a fresh session, /resume reopens an earlier one, /cwd sets the working directory.
empty.title: No messages yet

error.no_bridge: Could not reach the Claude Code bridge. Check the shell log for bridge.py errors.
error.no_claude: The claude CLI was not found. Install Claude Code, or set the binary path in this plugin's settings.
error.no_python: python3 was not found on PATH. The bridge that hosts the Claude Code session needs it.

header.mode_tooltip: Permission mode — applied to the live session
header.model_tooltip: Model — applied to the live session

mode_hint.auto: Claude Code decides when to ask — the default
mode_hint.bypass_permissions: No prompts at all — full access
mode_hint.dont_ask: Never prompt; denied actions just fail
mode_hint.plan: Read and reason only, no changes

done.body: The turn finished while the console was closed.
done.title: Claude Code is done

permission.body: A tool call is waiting for you to allow or deny it.
permission.title: Claude Code needs permission

sessions.none: No earlier sessions in this directory

binary.description: Name or absolute path of the Claude Code CLI
binary.label: Claude Code binary

idle_shutdown_minutes.description: Stop the background session after this many idle minutes. 0 keeps it warm, which is what makes replies start instantly.
idle_shutdown_minutes.label: Idle shutdown (minutes)

notify_on_idle.description: Send a notification when a turn finishes or needs permission while the console is closed
notify_on_idle.label: Notify when the console is closed

permission_prompts.description: What to do when the session asks to use a tool
permission_prompts.label: Tool permission requests

permission_timeout.description: How long an unanswered permission request waits before it is denied, so a forgotten prompt cannot wedge the session
permission_timeout.label: Permission timeout (seconds)

show_glyph.label: Show the icon in the bar

usage_refresh_minutes.description: How often to re-read your subscription usage
usage_refresh_minutes.label: Usage refresh (minutes)

usage_window.description: Which rate-limit window the pill's percentage tracks
usage_window.label: Usage window

working_dir.description: Directory Claude Code starts in. Empty means your home directory. /cwd changes it for the running session.
working_dir.label: Working directory

transcript.truncated: Output truncated — see the full result in the session log.
